content_data.meeting_title: Project Phoenix - Cost Reduction Pilot Steering Committee Check-in
agenda_items: Discussion on potential resistance points and mitigation strategies
Resource allocation for next phase of pilot implementation
Review of current cost-saving initiatives progress (Week 3)
key_decisions: Agreed to conduct a workshop with line supervisors next week to address workflow concerns and gather feedback.
Approved reallocation of three junior production staff to support data collection efforts for the next two weeks.
Decided to prioritize vendor renegotiation with Supplier B for raw materials, targeting a 5% price reduction.
Endorsed the use of a new inventory management software module for the pilot area, commencing deployment in the upcoming period.
action_items: Refine KPI dashboard for weekly progress tracking. (Owner: Consulting Analyst; Due: +4 days)
Prepare detailed report on manufacturing line efficiency gains for presentation to Executive Leadership. (Owner: Consulting Lead; Due: +5 days)
Develop communication plan for the new cost-saving idea generation channel. (Owner: HR Director; Due: +3 days)
Organize and lead the supervisor feedback workshop. (Owner: Operations Director; Due: +8 days)
Initiate procurement process for new inventory management software module. (Owner: IT Lead; Due: +10 days)
Schedule and facilitate vendor negotiation meeting with Supplier B. (Owner: Procurement Manager; Due: +7 days)
